title: Triage Category Classification
statement: The triage agent must categorize incoming inbound inquiries into exactly one of: Billing, Integration, or Outage.

title: High-Priority SLA Routing Threshold
statement: Billing inquiries marked urgent should be prioritized within a 15-minute response window.
rationale: Inferred from standard enterprise support tier templates. Awaiting human confirmation.

title: Unsupported Language Handling
statement: Handling policy for incoming inquiries in languages other than English.
question: When no translation tool is available, should foreign language inquiries be assigned to a general human review queue or sent an automated unsupported language response?
options: Route directly to general human exception queue
Send automated multi-lingual notification asking for English resubmission

title: Emergency Outage Alerting Dispatch
statement: Any inquiry categorized as Outage must trigger a mock pager alert without requiring account validation.
